title: XR input lifecycle debugging
description: A candidate debugging checklist for controller and hand-tracking transitions in XR projects.
knowledge: Reproduce the input failure on the target device and browser before assigning a root cause.
Log WebXR session lifecycle and input-source changes with timestamps, without collecting personal sensor data unnecessarily.
Inspect hand/controller fallback behavior, input state resets, and frame-loop tracking availability.
Add a regression fixture for the observed failure and measure behavior on the actual target hardware.
Treat this checklist as a debugging aid, not as evidence that any particular XR bug exists.
provenance: curated v0.1 engineering checklist; not a diagnosis of a repository
